title: Bebischnulli Totem
description: Transforms your totem of undying into an incubator.
body:
## Bebischnulli

This pack was mainly made for the german minecraft project Craftattack.

It makes your totem look like an incubator and *maybe* also changes something about carved pumpkins.

## Issues

When put in an itemframe, it looks kind of weird, which is a sacrifice to make the pop animation funnier.
